assemble_rcnn_outputs_by_name: assemble caffe2 model tensor outputs into detectron2 Instances with boxes, scores, masks, and keypoints
set_caffe2_compatible_tensor_mode: set tensor_mode on all Caffe2Compatible submodules of a detectron2 model for Caffe2 export compatibility
convert_batched_inputs_to_c2_format: convert detectron2 batched inputs into caffe2-style NCHW tensor and im_info tuple for inference
Caffe2GeneralizedRCNN_forward: run a patched GeneralizedRCNN model forward pass in caffe2-compatible tensor mode and return flattened outputs
Caffe2RetinaNet_encode_additional_info: encode RetinaNet inference parameters like score threshold, NMS threshold, and anchor generator config into protobuf args
